name: research_agent
description: Has an LLM supervisor judge whether web search results (via Tavily) are sufficient to answer a question, re-searching up to the iteration cap if not, then synthesizes a final answer. Requires TAVILY_API_KEY and GROQ_API_KEY to be set on the worker. Built for #39: exercises supervisor against real, unpredictable LLM output rather than simulated test payloads. judge has no depends_on and no prior search to judge on iteration 0, so first_iteration_step (#56) forces its first move to be search structurally, instead of relying on prompt text to make the model say 'search' first. This isn't just a nicety: handleSupervisorDecision requires at least one option to have run before 'done' is valid, since judge's own result comes from the last option's output, and a live Groq call once confirmed the model will say 'done' immediately given the chance, which the engine then correctly rejects with no usable result to fall back on.

steps.prompt_template:
You are deciding whether web search results are sufficient to answer a question.

Question: {{user_input}}

Most recent search results:
{{search.output}}

If the results so far are sufficient to answer the question, respond with exactly: done
Otherwise, respond with exactly: search

Respond with only one of those two words, nothing else.
